svg.title: Female anatomy · Half-transparent
svg.desc: Full-body anterior female anatomical mannequin divided at the median plane, with an intact external half and a transparent half exposing the brain, skeleton, major muscles, vessels, thoracoabdominal organs, urinary tract, uterus, ovary, and uterine tube. Design basis: A vertical split preserves the relationship between surface anatomy and internal position while sex-specific pelvic anatomy is shown without labels or explicit external detail.
